name: through_slot
why: A slot for M10 that slides 40 mm: 11 wide, 51 long outside to outside. THE DOUBT IS THE DIRECTION OF THE ARCS: if «Direction» is wrong the arc turns the long way round -- 270 degrees instead of 90 -- and the outline intersects itself. The cut succeeds just the same and removes a different shape: the volume says so at the first comparison.

expect.tolerance_why: (51-11)*11 + pi*5.5^2 = 535.0332: the operation rounds to the hundredth
535.0332 over 20 of thickness: the calculation has pi inside
480000 minus the slot: the calculation has pi inside
